status_note: Staged and launched through scripts/campaign.py on both hosts, so both binaries' commits were verified before launch. av2 (avlab12) started 2026-08-22T03:41:21+0100 and av3 started 2026-08-22T03:46:32+0100. 750 rows per host, 1500 merged, seeds 0-19 complete over 3 arms and 25 families.
kind: repair campaign (TLSF), three arms, external paired control
kind_note: Sweep T has three levels and no fourth arm. The control is the 500 archived counter rows of 2026-08-21-aurus-h2h-ship, paired on (spec, seed) over the same corpus, seeds, 7200 s cap, compare_timeout, hosts and seed split. PLAN.md section 4 declares that pairing.
question: What the three grammar changes and the elitism default move on feat/monotone-operators are worth on repair quality, one contrast at a time: the Implies widening of f320d8c (control -> monooff, across a binary change), the monotone rewrite b9276a3 plus the cloned assumption 3fd216a (monooff -> monoon, the primary), the elitism_rate move c0641ae (monoon -> monoship), and the branch as it ships (control -> monoship).
endpoint: Per-run implies_ideal, scored by compare against examples/<spec>/fixes, aggregated to a per-family rate over 20 seeds and read with a two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test over families at alpha 0.05, with a second read over the 10 correlated-family clusters. PLAN.md section 5. Where the two disagree, the clustered read governs.

arms.shared: nsga2-apportion, log metric, weakening screen off, 7200 s wall cap, compare_timeout 1800 s, jobs 8, 25 families of H2H_TLSF_READY at seeds 0-19

primary_monooff_to_monoon.note: The registered primary. It is the only contrast whose two sides come from the same binary.
primary_monooff_to_monoon.per_cluster_note: Three clusters rise and four fall. pcar-v2-888 falls by 0.250 alone, and Wilcoxon ranks by magnitude, so that one single-family cluster outranks every gain and carries the sign of the clustered statistic. Recorded as where the signal sits, and not as a reason to discount the clustered read: PLAN.md section 5 named that read as the tiebreaker in advance so that a post-hoc look at which cluster moved could not rescue the result.

control_to_monooff.note: The Implies widening of f320d8c alone, across a binary change. Secondary.

monoon_to_monoship.note: The elitism_rate move c0641ae, 0.1 -> 0.0, at nsga2-apportion. Secondary.

clustered.informative_note: No p under 0.05 exists at 5 non-tied clusters, so this read is uninformative by construction rather than by result.

control_to_monoship.note: The branch as it ships, against the archived control. Secondary.

against_aurus.note: Context only. Not this campaign's endpoint and gates nothing. Read under the 2026-08-14 rule, with AuRUS's rate filtered to well-separated repairs, over the same archived AuRUS rows.
against_aurus.verdict: No arm separates from AuRUS at either read.

clusters_aurus_still_leads.gyro: AuRUS 0.383 against 0.050 on monoon; gyro-var2 alone 0.700 against 0.100
clusters_aurus_still_leads.lift: AuRUS 0.300 against 0.000 on every counter arm

against_aurus.targeting_note: gyro and lift are the two clusters feat/monotone-operators was written for, and both are unmoved.

decision_rule_firing: Outcome 3 as PLAN.md section 5 wrote it. The per-family and clustered reads disagree in direction on the primary -- 0.490 -> 0.510 per family against 0.482 -> 0.465 clustered -- and section 5 gives the clustered read precedence where they disagree, so the rule fires outcome 3: both defaults to 0, no re-run, no post-hoc arm.
decision: OVERRIDDEN. p_monotone and p_clone_assumption both ship at 0.25. This is a deliberate departure from the pre-registered rule and is recorded as one rather than reported as a finding. The grounds are that sweep T moves the two probabilities together in every arm, with no arm at (0.25, 0) or (0, 0.25), so the primary tests the pair as one factor and outcome 3 would dispose severally of two operators the design only ever tested jointly; that b9276a3 (monotone rewrites of an existing formula) and 3fd216a (appending a copy of a live ASSUME conjunct rather than a template one) are unrelated moves that could point opposite ways and cancel to the measured null, which this design cannot tell apart from both being inert; and that section 5 owes a probability sweep under outcomes 1 and 2 and owes nothing under outcome 3, an asymmetry that is a defect in the plan rather than a result from the data. The concentration of the clustered reversal in pcar-v2-888 is recorded above as an observation and is explicitly not among the grounds.
owed: The 2x2 that varies p_monotone and p_clone_assumption independently, which is the only design that attributes anything to either operator alone.
The probability sweep PLAN.md section 5 already owed over the two 0.25 values, which were argued rather than measured.

Same position as provenance/tlsf-branch and provenance/replicate-campaign, and it arises the same way -- a branch whose content reached main under fresh shas rather than by merge.

reproduce: python3 scripts/analyse_monotone.py experiments/2026-08-23-monotone --control ../2026-08-21-aurus-h2h-ship, from any checkout carrying the vendored scripts/ beside this file. Every figure in REPORT.md comes from that one command. The campaign itself re-runs from campaign.toml at 6b78709; gen_configs.py writes the config tree on the host at stage time.

vendored_scripts.note: Verbatim copies of the drivers that ran the campaign. All four were verified byte-identical to the source commit's own. Check a copy with `git hash-object experiments/2026-08-23-monotone/scripts/<file>`.

analysis_script.note: Sits in the same directory as the vendored drivers and is not one of them. It was written after the campaign to read the merged CSVs and ran nothing, so it carries no blob sha here and no claim about which revision produced the rows.

known_caveats.joint_factor: p_monotone and p_clone_assumption never vary independently. Every arm sets both to the same value, so nothing in this campaign attributes anything to either operator alone. This is the first of the two owed measurements.
known_caveats.external_control: The control is another campaign's archive rather than an arm of this one. The corpus, seeds, 7200 s cap, compare_timeout, hosts and seed split all match, and both sides record their own commit, but the two counter arms differ in more than sweep T's factors because the control ran at a different binary. The internal contrasts do not carry this.
known_caveats.config_vintage: --pin-vintage was deliberately not passed, for the reason aurus-h2h-ship records: it writes run_well_separation from a gen_configs.DEFAULTS entry stale since b101ada. run_well_separation and allow_output_assumptions therefore ride the binary defaults on all three arms; PLAN.md records the values.
known_caveats.clustered_power: The primary's clustered read has 7 non-tied clusters, so its exact two-sided p floor is 2/2^7 = 0.0156 and it needs near-unanimity across clusters to reach 0.05 at all. The monoon -> monoship clustered read has 5, floor 0.0625, where no p under 0.05 exists.
known_caveats.curated_ideals: implies_ideal is scored against counter's curated ideal set in examples/<spec>/fixes, identically for every arm, so an incomparable family biases absolute rates rather than the paired differences.
known_caveats.implies_widening: The Implies widening f320d8c has no config key, so it rides in every arm here. It is attributable only against the archived control, across a binary change, and is invisible in the internal contrasts. PLAN.md section 6 registered this.
